_meta.description: Prior knowledge base of US local-service and pay-per-call niches for triage. Every number is an INDICATIVE PRIOR to rank/compare niches - NOT validated data. Phase 3-5 (keyword, SERP, economics) must replace priors with live data before any GO decision.

fields.model_fit: 0-10 fit for each monetization model: rank_and_rent (rent a local site), pay_per_call (local calls sold via networks/buyers), nationwide (one brand/site monetized across many states via networks)
fields.ticket_usd: Typical customer job value range. 0,0 = not a job-ticket business (insurance/finance) -> use ppc_payout_usd
fields.urgency: emergency | mixed | planned - emergency niches produce more phone calls and higher payouts
fields.demand_tier: Relative local search demand for the core service cluster. See demand_tiers for order-of-magnitude priors
fields.lsa_presence: Likelihood of Google Local Services Ads above organic results (reduces organic CTR, but proves buyers pay for leads)
fields.directory_pressure: How much directories/aggregators (Angi, Yelp, Thumbtack, national brokers) occupy organic results
fields.competition_baseline: Typical organic difficulty in a mid-size US city before any SERP audit
fields.ppc_payout_usd: Indicative pay-per-call payout per qualified call (varies hugely by ZIP, buyer, hour, buffer). null = little/no network demand
fields.call_buffer_sec: Typical minimum call duration for a call to be billable
fields.rent_usd_month: Indicative monthly rent a single tenant pays for a ranking site producing steady leads. null = not a rental niche
fields.per_lead_usd: Indicative price per qualified exclusive lead/call when selling per lead to a local buyer
fields.buyer_density: How many potential tenants/buyers exist per market
fields.license_sensitivity: How much contractor/professional licensing affects what the site may claim/advertise
fields.regulatory_risk: low | medium | high | extreme - extra laws on marketing/lead-gen in this vertical
fields.spam_scrutiny: How aggressively Google polices fake listings/spam in this category
fields.market_profile: rural | suburban | urban | affluent - which kind of market the niche monetizes best in; sets city_finder's default population sweet spot and ideal service-area cluster size
fields.schema_type: schema.org type to use ONLY in tenant mode (real business). Lead-gen mode uses Organization + Service

_meta.demand_tier_note: Tier ranges are deliberately wide order-of-magnitude priors for the whole transactional keyword cluster (including 'near me' searches made inside the city). Use ONLY for triage. Real volumes come from Google Keyword Planner / DataForSEO / Ahrefs / Semrush in Phase 3.
_meta.sources_note: Ranges synthesized from public cost guides, pay-per-call network marketplaces and rank-and-rent practitioner benchmarks as of 2026. Payouts and rents move with ZIP, season and buyer - always confirm with the current offer/tenant.

niches.name: Roofing
niches.notes: Highest-value classic R&R niche but competitive in metros. Several states license roofers and restrict insurance-claim solicitation / deductible waivers (verify state rules). Storm-chaser competition after events.

niches.name: Siding Installation & Repair
niches.notes: Pairs well with roofing/gutters. National exterior remodelers buy calls in many metros.

niches.name: Gutter Installation & Gutter Guards
niches.peak: Fall leaf season and spring rains
niches.notes: National gutter-guard brands buy calls broadly (good nationwide PPC). Local R&R is solid in wooded suburbs.

niches.name: Gutter Cleaning
niches.notes: Low ticket; best as a page on a gutter or pressure-washing site, not a standalone rental.

niches.name: Window Replacement
niches.notes: Strong national buyers (big window brands) -> good nationwide PPC. Local SERPs often dominated by national brands.

niches.name: House Painting
niches.notes: Many buyers, modest budgets. Thumbtack/Angi heavy.

niches.name: Pressure Washing
niches.notes: Low barrier to entry -> many operators with small budgets. Easy to rank, harder to rent at a good price.

niches.name: Window Cleaning
niches.notes: Low ticket. Commercial (storefront/office) contracts add LTV.

niches.name: Christmas Light Installation
niches.notes: Seasonal rental only (often bundled with landscaping/pressure washing buyers). Index content by August.

niches.name: Water Damage Restoration
niches.peak: Winter pipe bursts, spring floods, storm events
niches.notes: Top pay-per-call vertical (insurance-paid jobs). National franchises compete hard in metros. Some states restrict assignment-of-benefits and public-adjusting -> never imply you handle insurance claims.

niches.name: Fire & Smoke Damage Restoration
niches.notes: Low volume, very high value. Usually a section of a water-damage site rather than a standalone build.

niches.name: Mold Remediation
niches.notes: Several states license mold assessors/remediators (e.g. TX, FL, NY, LA) -> tenant must hold the license; avoid health claims.

niches.name: Biohazard & Crime Scene Cleanup
niches.notes: Sensitive audience: write with compassion, no sensational content. Few buyers per metro -> pre-sell first.

niches.name: Hoarding Cleanup
niches.notes: Often bundled with junk removal or biohazard buyers.

niches.name: Plumbing
niches.notes: Huge volume and many buyers, but LSAs + ads push organic far down. Best in small/mid cities or as niche sub-service sites (water heaters, sewer lines). Licensed trade: tenant license number required on site.

niches.name: Water Heater Repair & Installation
niches.notes: Sub-niche of plumbing with less competition and a clear high-intent emergency.

niches.name: Drain Cleaning & Sewer Repair
niches.notes: Sewer line replacement tickets are large; older-housing cities convert best.

niches.name: Septic Services
niches.notes: Classic low-competition R&R niche in rural/exurban counties. Target a county or metro fringe rather than one town.

niches.name: HVAC (AC & Heating)
niches.notes: Strong buyers and payouts; volatile seasonality. Replacement installs ($6k-$15k) make leads very valuable.

niches.name: Electrician
niches.notes: Licensed trade. Panel upgrades and EV chargers are rising sub-niches.

niches.name: EV Charger Installation
niches.notes: Strongest in high-EV-adoption metros (verify with state EV registration data). Must be a licensed electrician.

niches.name: Standby Generator Installation
niches.notes: Demand explodes after outages; don't use manufacturer trademarks as if you were an authorized dealer.

niches.name: Water Softeners & Filtration
niches.notes: Avoid health claims about contaminants unless sourced to official water-quality reports.

niches.name: Well Drilling & Well Pump Repair
niches.notes: Rural, low competition, emergency when water stops. Few buyers -> confirm a tenant exists before building.

niches.name: Radon Testing & Mitigation
niches.notes: Real-estate transaction driven. Several states certify radon professionals; cite EPA for health info only.

niches.name: Insulation (Spray Foam & Attic)
niches.notes: Rebate/tax-credit angles change often - verify current programs before writing about them.

niches.name: Chimney Sweep & Repair
niches.notes: Seasonal; few buyers per metro but low competition.

niches.name: Garage Door Repair
niches.notes: Heavy fake-listing history: Google applies extra scrutiny/verification in this category. Organic-only R&R is viable; never fake GBPs.

niches.name: Locksmith
niches.notes: Notorious scam category with advanced verification and low consumer trust; several states license locksmiths. Generally avoid for new operators.

niches.name: Appliance Repair
niches.notes: Fake-listing problems exist here too. Don't claim brand authorization (e.g. 'authorized Whirlpool service') unless the tenant is.

niches.name: Handyman Services
niches.notes: Many states cap unlicensed handyman job size (e.g. California's minor-work threshold) -> scope pages accordingly.

niches.name: Drywall Repair & Installation
niches.notes: Easy to rank, modest rent. Good add-on page for handyman/painting sites.

niches.name: Home Inspection
niches.notes: Buyers come from agent referrals -> SEO leads are a supplement; many states license inspectors.

niches.name: Pest Control
niches.notes: Recurring-plan LTV makes leads valuable; national brands buy calls widely. Applicators are state-licensed.

niches.name: Termite Control
niches.notes: Strong in the South/Southwest; real-estate WDO inspections add steady volume.

niches.name: Bed Bug Extermination
niches.notes: Urban/dense metros and college towns. Emergency + high ticket = good calls.

niches.name: Wildlife & Animal Removal
niches.notes: Low competition, urgent calls. Many states require nuisance-wildlife permits; avoid content advising illegal trapping/poisons.

niches.name: Mosquito Control
niches.notes: Seasonal recurring plans; usually rented to pest-control or lawn-care companies.

niches.name: Tree Service
niches.notes: Benchmark R&R niche: real tickets, many small owner-operators, moderate competition. A few states license arborists/tree experts (verify).

niches.name: Stump Grinding
niches.notes: Better as a page on a tree-service site; standalone only in small markets.

niches.name: Land Clearing & Forestry Mulching
niches.notes: Exurban growth corridors. Operators carry expensive equipment and need steady work -> good tenants.

niches.name: Excavation & Grading
niches.notes: Mixed B2B/residential; big tickets, few searches. Bundle with land clearing.

niches.name: Concrete Contractor
niches.notes: Popular R&R niche: lots of small contractors, low LSA presence.

niches.name: Foundation Repair
niches.notes: High value; national foundation brands compete in large metros. Expansive-clay regions are prime.

niches.name: Basement Waterproofing
niches.notes: Midwest/Northeast staple; urgent after heavy rain.

niches.name: Crawl Space Repair & Encapsulation
niches.notes: Southeast-heavy; often the same buyers as foundation/waterproofing.

niches.name: Fence Installation
niches.notes: Reliable R&R niche; HOA/permit rules make great unique local content.

niches.name: Deck Builder
niches.notes: High ticket, seasonal. Permit requirements per city = unique content.

niches.name: Hardscaping, Pavers & Retaining Walls
niches.notes: High ticket and low competition in many mid-size cities.

niches.name: Landscaping
niches.notes: Design/install jobs are valuable; maintenance leads are cheap.

niches.name: Lawn Care & Mowing
niches.notes: Low ticket; aggregator apps dominate. Recurring LTV only partly offsets.

niches.name: Irrigation & Sprinkler Repair
niches.notes: Texas requires licensed irrigators (TCEQ); verify other states.

niches.name: Artificial Turf Installation
niches.notes: Water-restriction regions (AZ, NV, CA, TX) are strongest; rebates change - verify.

niches.name: Pool Service & Repair
niches.peak: Spring opening; year-round in Sun Belt
niches.notes: Recurring revenue; Sun Belt only.

niches.name: Pool Builder
niches.notes: Huge tickets, long sales cycles; leads worth $100+ to builders. Several Sun Belt states license pool contractors.

niches.name: Snow Removal & Plowing
niches.notes: Commercial seasonal contracts are the prize. Seasonal rental only.

niches.name: Asphalt Paving & Sealcoating
niches.notes: Residential + commercial; watch for transient paving-scam reputation in content tone.

niches.name: Demolition
niches.notes: Asbestos surveys are often legally required before demolition - mention, don't advise.

niches.name: Metal Buildings, Garages & Pole Barns
niches.notes: Rural/exurban; very high ticket per lead.

niches.name: Kitchen Remodeling
niches.notes: Houzz/Angi dominate; strong portfolio content needed (tenant photos).

niches.name: Bathroom Remodeling
niches.notes: National one-day bath remodelers buy calls aggressively -> good nationwide PPC.

niches.name: Walk-In Tubs & Senior Bath Safety
niches.notes: Nationwide PPC play. Senior audience: avoid pressure tactics and unsubstantiated Medicare/coverage claims.

niches.name: Flooring Installation
niches.notes: Retail flooring stores compete; installers love direct leads.

niches.name: Epoxy & Garage Floor Coatings
niches.notes: Low competition, decent ticket; growing niche popular with R&R operators.

niches.name: Countertop Installation
niches.notes: Fabricator showrooms compete; leads valued by fabricators.

niches.name: Cabinet Refinishing & Refacing
niches.notes: Lower competition than full remodels.

niches.name: Junk Removal
niches.notes: Popular R&R niche: easy to rank, many owner-operators; franchises compete in metros.

niches.name: Dumpster Rental
niches.notes: Classic R&R niche, but national dumpster brokers rank city pages everywhere - audit SERPs carefully. Contractor repeat business raises tenant LTV.

niches.name: Portable Toilet Rental
niches.notes: B2B + events; few buyers per metro, low competition.

niches.name: Local Movers
niches.notes: Scam-prone category; state household-goods permits and FMCSA rules (interstate) apply. Never broker moves without authority.

niches.name: Long-Distance Moving
niches.notes: Nationwide PPC only. Brokering interstate moves requires FMCSA broker authority; route calls only to registered carriers/brokers.

niches.name: Carpet Cleaning
niches.notes: Low ticket; rent is limited.

niches.name: House Cleaning & Maid Service
niches.notes: Recurring LTV, low ticket; app aggregators compete.

niches.name: Commercial & Janitorial Cleaning
niches.notes: B2B monthly contracts -> very high LTV per lead. Leads are forms more than calls.

niches.name: Towing & Roadside Assistance
niches.notes: Low ticket, high volume; national roadside networks buy calls. Many cities permit/regulate tow operators.

niches.name: Auto Glass Repair
niches.notes: National chains dominate; insurance rules vary by state (some require $0-deductible glass coverage).

niches.name: Junk Car Buying (Cash for Cars)
niches.notes: Title-transfer rules vary by state - don't advise around them.

niches.name: Mobile Mechanic
niches.notes: Low competition; buyers are small operators.

niches.name: Home Security Systems
niches.notes: Nationwide PPC buyers are large; many states license alarm installers.

niches.name: Solar Installation
niches.notes: Heavily regulated and litigated lead-gen vertical (TCPA, state solar consumer-protection laws, incentive claims). Expert operators only; never state incentive amounts without a current official source.

niches.name: Commercial Roofing
niches.notes: Few searches, huge contracts; leads are mostly forms from property managers.

niches.name: Personal Injury / Auto Accident Lawyer
niches.notes: Highest payouts, hardest SERPs, strict state-bar advertising and referral-fee rules (ABA Model Rule 7.2 variants). Prefer flat-fee advertising arrangements; verify bar rules per state before renting. No guarantees of outcomes.

niches.name: Criminal Defense / DUI Lawyer
niches.notes: Same bar-advertising constraints as PI. Never give legal advice in content.

niches.name: Bail Bonds
niches.notes: Organic-only niche (Google Ads prohibits bail bond ads). Commercial bail is banned or eliminated in some states (e.g. IL, KY, OR, WI) - verify state law; agents must be state-licensed.

niches.name: Auto Insurance
niches.notes: Nationwide PPC only; comparison giants own SERPs. Content discussing specific rates/coverage may require producer licensing; strict TCPA consent for any outbound contact.

niches.name: Medicare Plans
niches.notes: EXTREME regulation (CMS third-party marketing organization rules, required disclaimers, call recording). Avoid unless counseled.

niches.name: Final Expense Insurance
niches.notes: Senior audience + insurance regulation. Nationwide PPC only.

niches.name: Debt Relief
niches.notes: FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule + state debt-settlement laws. Never promise results or 'government programs'.

niches.name: Tax Debt Relief
niches.notes: Heavy FTC enforcement history; no outcome promises.

niches.name: Home Warranty
niches.notes: Nationwide PPC only; review-site SERPs.

niches.name: Medical Alert Systems
niches.notes: Senior audience; avoid trademark misuse (e.g. 'Life Alert' is a brand).

niches.name: Hearing Aids
niches.notes: Health claims need sourcing; dispensers are state-licensed.

niches.name: Dental Implants & Emergency Dentist
niches.notes: Healthcare advertising rules apply; don't collect health details in forms (privacy/HIPAA exposure for the tenant).

niches.name: Addiction Treatment / Rehab
niches.notes: DO NOT PURSUE without specialist counsel: federal EKRA (18 U.S.C. 220) and state patient-brokering laws can make per-referral payments illegal; LegitScript certification needed for ads. Included only so the system can reject it.

niches.name: Senior Living Placement
niches.notes: Some states regulate placement/referral agencies (registration, disclosures). National referral brands dominate.

niches.name: Car Shipping / Auto Transport
niches.notes: FMCSA broker authority required to arrange transport; lead-gen publishers must not act as brokers.

niches.name: Asbestos Testing & Abatement
niches.notes: State/EPA accreditation required; health content must cite EPA/OSHA. Never give DIY removal instructions.
